title: Generate and derive remote keys
responsibility: Create P-256 key pairs, validate imported pairs and derive shared secrets and AES keys.

inputs.name: sharedSecret.privateKey
inputs.description: Local P-256 private key authorized for key agreement.

inputs.name: importRemoteKeys.stored
inputs.description: Base64url private scalar and public point to import and cross-check.

inputs.name: exportRemoteKeys.pair
inputs.description: Key pair with an exportable private key and its public bytes.

inputs.name: deriveBytes.info
inputs.description: HKDF context bytes or text encoded as UTF-8.

inputs.name: aesKey.bytes
inputs.description: Raw AES key bytes to import.

outputs.name: remoteKeys
outputs.description: Fresh P-256 public bytes and extractable private CryptoKey.

outputs.name: importRemoteKeys
outputs.description: Imported key pair after a fresh probe confirms the public and private halves agree.

outputs.name: exportRemoteKeys
outputs.description: Private scalar and public point encoded as base64url; this helper does not persist them.

outputs.name: deriveBytes
outputs.description: HKDF-SHA256 output of the requested byte length.

outputs.name: aesKey
outputs.description: Nonextractable AES-GCM key with encrypt and decrypt usages.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects malformed or mismatched key pairs, unexportable private keys and unsupported cryptographic inputs or lengths.
